failureConditions: Character root paths unavailable for all non-local entities
requests.requiredObservationWindow: At least one full live round with >=3 visible players.
requests.safeObservationMethod: Read-only tracking of PlayerAdded/CharacterAdded, Humanoid, HumanoidRootPart positions, and team changes.
successCriteria: At least two non-local character entities captured with spatial samples
Team relationship snapshots captured for the same entities
requests.whyNeeded: Targeting and ESP capabilities require opponent entity, team, and spatial evidence.

failureConditions: No weapon-related state transitions during firing
requests.requiredObservationWindow: Three burst sequences plus one non-firing camera pan sequence.
requests.safeObservationMethod: Read-only sampling of camera orientation, equipped tool identity, and HUD/state changes during controlled firing bursts.
successCriteria: Camera sample stream available during firing and non-firing windows
Weapon state transitions aligned to firing windows
requests.whyNeeded: Recoil and trigger capabilities require camera/weapon temporal evidence, not click-only signals.

requests.requiredObservationWindow: Pre-round, mid-round, and round-end transition window.

successCriteria: At least one timer or objective value transition captured
Transitions aligned with known round phase change
requests.whyNeeded: Objective dashboard capability requires reactive state transitions, not static HUD paths.

requests.requiredObservationWindow: At least two loadout switches and one in-match weapon swap.
requests.safeObservationMethod: Read-only capture while switching weapons/loadouts in menu and live state.

successCriteria: Tool identity changes captured during switches
HUD indicators update in sync with tool changes
